title: cereus polygonus
intro: Cereus polygonus, commonly known as the 'Dragon Fruit Cactus', is a species of cactus in the family Cactaceae. It is a perennial plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Cereus polygonus include its ability to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and potential health benefits.
